main_text.p: Psalterij à se editi tomus alter est dicatus. Habet & populares suos, D. Ladislaum Baronem Zerotinum, cum præfecto Georgio Scherhakelio ab Harttenfels: & D. Zdenkonem Brtnicensem, Baronem Vals steinium, cum ephoro suo Adamo Ropalio à Riffemberg, aliósque amicos Generosissimos, qui suis virtutibus currenti calcar addere possent. Eorum enim, quos nominaui studia, peregrinationes, & conatus, ad hunc finem omnino sunt directi, vt exemplo sint posteris, suisque confiliis aliquando Rempublicam & patriam iuuent. Sed & magnas data hac occasione, atque immortales habeo gratias, Illustrissimo Heroi, ac Domino Carolo Baroni Zerotino, Arte & Marte clarissimo, perpetuo Moraviæ, ac familiæ Zerotinorum ornamento, Cognato nostro multis nominibus obseruando, quòd literis suis ac commedationibus chariores nos D. Bezæ efficere studuerit & dignatus sit: vnde, quū nō exigua mihi fluxerint commoda, precamur Deum

page.notes: Page text is set in roman type with long s; the last line is "Deum" followed by a printed catchword-like word "Deum" at right, reproduced as the final line. Some ligatures and worn letters (e.g., "Psalterij", "Scherhakelio") are transcribed as printed; doubtful: "Brtnicensem" and "Riffemberg" read as printed.
